features.name: Direct technical conversation
features.description: Naya answers questions across technical domains without dumbing down or padding answers with filler.
features.notes: Domains: AI/ML, physics, programming, networking, VMs, Docker, languages, sysadmin

features.name: Telegram is the chat surface
features.description: the owner talks to Naya through the @Naya_qi_bot Telegram bot. Long-poll only, so no public URL is ever exposed; only authorised chat IDs are answered.
features.notes: naya.telegram_allowed_chat_ids gate; runs as a daemon polling thread inside the server

features.name: 8-model LLM chain with failover
features.description: If one model is down or slow, Naya automatically tries the next in priority order until it gets a usable answer.
features.notes: llm_chain table in naya.db: DeepSeek-R1 8B -> Cloudflare Qwen -> GPT-OSS 20B local -> Gemma3:27b -> Qwen3:4b -> MiniMax M2.5 -> GPT-OSS 120B -> Claude Sonnet

features.name: Local-first, free-first models
features.description: Local Ollama models answer first (free, private, offline). Free cloud tiers next. Claude Sonnet is reserved as the high-quality last resort.
features.notes: personal.anthropic_mode = fallback | always | never

features.name: Multi-AI synthesis via NEXUS
features.description: For genuinely hard questions Naya can ask the sibling NEXUS project to fan one prompt out to many AIs and merge the best answer.
features.notes: _try_nexus_synthesize() calls NEXUS :8010 /synthesize; gated by personal.nexus_enabled (off by default)

features.name: Conversation memory
features.description: Naya remembers earlier turns in a conversation and builds on them.
features.notes: conversations table (690 rows); sliding window per conv_key, personal.history_limit = 30

features.name: Multi-language
features.description: Naya detects the owner's language and responds in it, reusing Maia's language engine.
features.notes: maia_lang.detect_input_language + build_language_instruction

features.name: Find exact duplicates
features.description: Naya scans drives and finds files that are byte-for-byte identical, grouping them and reporting how much space you would reclaim by keeping one copy.
features.notes: naya_scanner.start_exact_scan — size pre-filter then SHA-256; results in naya_brain.db (2.7M similarity-group rows recorded)

features.name: Find near-duplicates by name
features.description: Catches files that are not identical but clearly related — same name, slightly different content — so scattered versions can be reconciled.
features.notes: naya_scanner.start_fuzzy_scan — difflib fuzzy name matching

features.name: Disk space analysis
features.description: Ask 'where did my space go?' and Naya reports drive usage plus ranked cleanup candidates: temp, browser/app caches, recycle bin, duplicates, old large files.
features.notes: naya_advisor.analyze_storage — combines its own scanners with FileHQ index queries

features.name: Find largest / oldest files
features.description: Surface the biggest disk hogs or the files you have not touched in years.
features.notes: find_largest / find_oldest action handlers

features.name: Folder insights
features.description: Ask 'what's in folder X?' and Naya summarises counts, total size, dominant file types, age range, and the top files.
features.notes: naya_memory.folder_insight — reads the FileHQ index, caches in naya_brain.db for 24h

features.name: USB cross-reference
features.description: Plug in a USB drive and Naya can compare its contents against your main drive to flag what is already a duplicate.
features.notes: naya_scanner.detect_usb_belongings

features.name: Configurable scan target
features.description: The drive Naya scans is a config value, not hardcoded — point it anywhere.
features.notes: personal.default_scan_drive (default C:\1-AI); personal.file_scan_root

features.name: Cleanup advisor workflow
features.description: The 'running out of space' flow: Naya analyses, proposes a plan, remembers it, and executes only on your approval.
features.notes: naya_advisor.create_plan / handle_chat; plans stored in naya_brain.db

features.name: Permission gate
features.description: Every file-modifying action requires explicit approval. A blocked action tells you the exact phrase to say to enable it, then retry.
features.notes: _is_approved() checks naya.db flags; personal.file_modify_approved=false, file_scan_approved=true

features.name: Recycle-bin-first deletes
features.description: Deletions go to the Windows recycle bin by default. Permanent deletion happens only on explicit consent.
features.notes: send2trash; permanent delete is opt-in

features.name: Undo
features.description: Naya moves files to a TRASH folder and logs every batch, so the last operation can be fully reversed.
features.notes: naya_executor.undo_last() / undo_batch(); operations logged in naya_brain.db

features.name: Never deletes the keep copy
features.description: When clearing duplicates, Naya always preserves one copy of each group (the oldest).
features.notes: naya_executor never removes is_oldest member

features.name: Reports in any format
features.description: Generate a space, duplicates, actions, deferred, or full report as PDF, Word, Markdown, or plain text.
features.notes: naya_reporter.generate_report; saved to C:\APPS\NAYA\REPORTS\

features.name: Chat-driven deferral
features.description: Say 'not now' or 'do it tonight' and Naya saves the pending action and runs it later, off-hours.
features.notes: naya_deferral; stored as naya_intents (status=deferred) in naya_brain.db

features.name: Natural-language scheduling
features.description: Say 'run daily at 2am' and Naya creates a real Windows Task Scheduler task to run the job on schedule.
features.notes: naya_deferral creates tasks under the Naya\ prefix via schtasks

features.name: Disk-space monitor
features.description: Naya watches every drive and alerts you on Telegram when free space drops below your threshold.
features.notes: naya_watcher.disk_monitor_tick; low_space_threshold_pct / _gb settings

features.name: USB watcher
features.description: Naya notices when a new external drive appears and can queue it for an overnight scan.
features.notes: naya_watcher.usb_watcher_tick — polls drive letters every ~60s

features.name: Off-hours scheduler
features.description: Heavy queued jobs run during configured quiet hours, with idle detection, so scans never compete with your work.
features.notes: naya_watcher off-hours scheduler tick; quiet_hours_start/end settings

features.name: Proactive reminders
features.description: If you once said 'I should clean folder X', Naya can resurface that intent later: 'You mentioned X a few weeks ago — want to do it now?'
features.notes: naya_memory.capture_intent + reminder_message injected at start of a turn

features.name: Gradio operator console
features.description: A local web console with Chat, File Manager, Naya Brain, Settings, and Logs tabs for managing Naya from the browser.
features.notes: naya_gradio.py on port 7861, QI_NayaGradio service

features.name: 24/7 Windows services
features.description: Naya runs as managed NSSM services so it is always available without a terminal open.
features.notes: QI_NayaBot (8002) + QI_NayaGradio (7861), both SERVICE_RUNNING

features.name: LAN-only by design
features.description: Naya is deliberately not exposed to the internet. Telegram works via outbound polling, so no inbound port is opened.
features.notes: Registry: never expose via Cloudflare. One demo tunnel (QI_NayaTunnel) exposes only the UI for occasional remote demos

features.name: FileHQ file engine (merged)
features.description: FileHQ was absorbed as Naya's file engine — a FastAPI service Naya can call for deep file content and indexing.
features.notes: filehq/ package, auto-started on internal port 8200 via filehq_bridge.py when first needed

features.name: Cross-bot peer bridge
features.description: Because Telegram refuses bot-to-bot delivery, Naya carries HMAC-signed messages to and from sibling bots (Tasuke, Maia) over an HTTP bridge in a shared chat.
features.notes: POST /webhook/peer-bridge; also janitors sibling-bot status-leak messages

features.name: LINE channel (Naya OA)
features.description: An optional LINE Official Account interface, off unless credentials are present.
features.notes: naya_line.py — no-ops gracefully without the LINE SDK or creds

features.name: QI Brain logging
features.description: Register Naya sessions and decisions in the QI Brain for cross-project memory.
features.notes: Not yet wired
